generator_patch: generate_sdxl.py was OOM-killed (anon-rss 13.9 GB, container memory cgroup) while loading the fp32 UNet. Patched minimally on this branch: a --bf16 flag holds the UNet and VAE in bfloat16 (text encoders stay fp32). Peak memory about 5.6 GB, about 60 s an image on this CPU (AMX bf16). All images were made with --bf16.
